name: grok-bot
title: Grok Bot
description: Unofficial Grok Bot client for Raycast on macOS (macOS only). Not on Raycast for iOS or Windows. Not affiliated with xAI.
author: maxence_maisonnat

commands.name: bots
commands.title: List Bots
commands.subtitle: Grok Bot
commands.description: Search your Grok Bot teammates and send a task

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Bot
commands.subtitle: Grok Bot
commands.description: Send a task to a Grok Bot teammate

commands.name: open-grok-bot
commands.title: Open Grok Bot
commands.subtitle: Grok Bot
commands.description: Open the Grok Bot desktop app

preferences.name: gatewayUrl
preferences.title: Gateway URL
preferences.description: Tailscale Serve URL for the Sand gateway, for example https://box.ts.net

preferences.name: gatewayToken
preferences.title: Gateway Token
preferences.description: Bearer token from gateway.json on the Bot computer. Treat it like a password.

tools.name: list-bots
tools.title: List Bots
tools.description: List Grok Bot teammates. Optional query filters by name or title.

tools.name: send-to-bot
tools.title: Send to Bot
tools.description: Send a prompt to a named Grok Bot teammate. Call list-bots when the name is unclear.
